job_description_info.job_description:
# Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity

**Company:** Corvale Mobility (fictional name; intercity rail and coach operator)
**Location:** Kraków, Poland (contract, remote-friendly; occasional office days)
**Engagement:** Service agreement (B2B / freelance), not an employment contract
**Rate:** 95 – 125 PLN per hour

## The engagement

Corvale is preparing a new generation of trains and needs a cloud infrastructure engineer for the team that links the vehicles to the company's cloud platform. You will help shape the architecture from the start and take it to production.

## Scope

- Design, build and operate the cloud infrastructure that links on-board train systems with backend services: telemetry ingestion, alerting, video streaming and remote content updates
- Maintain the infrastructure-as-code repository (Terraform with Terragrunt), keeping it tidy and approachable
- Lead technical proposals across backend and infrastructure from idea to production
- Contribute to system design and challenge decisions with arguments
- Set up secure train-to-cloud communication (mutual TLS, certificate management, network design)
- Agree interfaces and responsibilities with train manufacturers' engineers
- Support backend developers in deploying services that are easy to monitor and run
- Keep the platform observable, reliable and secure

## Requirements

- Hands-on infrastructure engineering and cloud environment design and operation
- AWS preferred; other major clouds acceptable
- Strong Terraform and Terragrunt
- Good understanding of systems architecture and system design
- Networking knowledge, including mTLS and SSL/TLS
- Practical security awareness
- Experience leading technical topics and bringing stakeholders along
- Strong analytical thinking and clear communication

**Nice to have:** IoT or automotive/remote-device integration, backend or full-stack background (JVM preferred), Linux and virtual machines.

## Working model

Independent contractor, invoicing monthly for agreed services.

company_info.company_description:
Corvale Mobility is a privately held, engineering-led transport and software company headquartered in Kraków, Poland. It runs long-distance bus services and a growing passenger-rail network in Central Europe, supported by an online platform for booking, trip tracking and travel extras. Its asset-light model combines regional operating partners with Corvale’s own network planning, technology and brand. The company is investing in a new train fleet and expanding its use of data and machine learning.

Corvale describes itself as technology-first, using software to improve how people travel, with sustainability built into its growth ambitions. Its stated values are **Lead, Shape, Own and Enjoy the journey**. The culture is described as collaborative, fast-moving and open to new ideas, with teams solving problems together and taking end-to-end ownership of their systems. The company also emphasizes international teams with shared goals, career ownership, professional development, employee appreciation and work-life flexibility. Some roles offer hybrid working, and technology positions may be available to employees or independent contractors.

Marta Kowal-Brandt

Polish (native) | English (C1) | German (A2)

cover_letter_history.content:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor role supporting Fleet Connectivity. Over the past two years, my QA automation work has focused primarily on CI/CD pipelines, test environments and build tooling. I am now looking to move into DevOps or platform engineering full time, and I am drawn to this opportunity to help build infrastructure for a new generation of connected trains.

At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines supporting three product teams and approximately 25 developers. I reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies and moving end-to-end tests to on-demand ephemeral environments. I built those environments with Docker Compose and later Helm charts on a shared Kubernetes cluster. This work has given me practical experience improving the reliability and operability of shared engineering systems, while working across teams to deliver changes that support developers.

I also maintain a pytest and Playwright suite of approximately 900 tests, reducing the flaky-test rate from 7% to under 1%, and have developed Python and Bash tooling for PostgreSQL test-data seeding. Earlier, I configured Jenkins jobs for nightly regression runs and investigated customer issues using logs and databases. I would bring this hands-on infrastructure, automation and analytical experience to Corvale’s work on a reliable, observable and secure train-to-cloud platform, while continuing to develop in the broader infrastructure engineering responsibilities of the role.

Corvale’s engineering-led approach and emphasis on end-to-end ownership make this role especially compelling to me. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience building and improving CI and test infrastructure could contribute to the Fleet Connectivity team.

Kind regards,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
